title: Describe a limitation
text: What is one limitation of your project?

options.text: The sample is small. I would test it on a larger and more varied sample.
options.response: 回答说明了关键条件和处理方法。

options.text: There is no limitation because the result is good.
options.response: 这一说法忽略了关键条件，需要重新分析。

options.text: I would collect more data, but I have not decided which data.
options.response: 提到了部分处理方式，但解释还不完整。
